title: The distutils module was removed in Python 3.12
summary: Python 3.12 removed distutils (PEP 632), so importing it raises ModuleNotFoundError; use setuptools or another build backend.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the distutils import
steps.instructions: Replace each reported import of distutils with setuptools.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings treated as errors when pytest is used.
